# Credits

**Ramon 40** — design, code, procedural art, audio and music generated by the game's own code.

## Engine

- **Godot Engine 4.7.2** — https://godotengine.org — MIT license. The exported Windows and Linux builds contain the official Godot export templates (MIT), which include third-party components listed at https://godotengine.org/license.

## Generated content

Everything else — terrain, roads, trees, rocks, signs, bikes, riders, textures, shaders, sky, particles, engine sounds, effects, ambience and the menu music — is created procedurally at runtime by the code in this repository. No external art, model or audio files are used.

## Inspiration

The tracks are inspired by Route 40 through Makhtesh Ramon, Route 90 along the Dead Sea, and Route 1 climbing to Jerusalem. The layouts are fictional loops shaped after the character of those roads.
